summary: Hold as a duplicate of landed work: master's _experts_marlin already runs _align_parallel (local routes only, no -1 blocks) and _silu_mul_sorted_kernel at T<=4096. Both were self-checked ON in the master jobs c4d14d62 and 502f2eab ('[align-local] ON', '[silu-sorted] ON'). Retire it; it does not need to wait for the running checks.
justification: Both parts landed with stack-tonight-five-prefill (moe-align-local-routes-parallel-port + silu-mul-triton-local-rows-marlin-turn). See submission.py _experts_marlin: _align_parallel(local_ids, 0, LOCAL_EXPERTS, block_size_m) when align_par_ok, and _silu_mul_sorted(...) when silu_sorted_ok. REWRITE_READ_2026-10-25 states that on the new master the parallel align and _silu_mul_sorted_kernel replace count_and_sort plus act_and_mul on the Marlin path. The hypothesis was written against 635cfee (pre-five), so its expected savings (act_and_mul 53->15-20 us, count_and_sort 17.4 us, ~330 remote m-blocks) are already in master's 1.0705/1.0744. The only residual difference is cosmetic. The hypothesis aligns straight from topk_ids plus data['local_start'] and skips _local_expert_ids, but it still returns local_ids for fused_post_expert_norm_weighted_sum, so at most one ~2-5 us remap launch is saved. That is far below the ±1.5% turn noise and not worth a check. WEAKEST LINK: the premise that master still runs moe_align_block_size + silu_and_mul on this path is false.
confounders: stack-tonight-five-prefill: it contains this hypothesis's two parts verbatim, so the run would measure master against master.
Running experts-triton-turn4-persistent-local-align-control-no-persi: if it wins, turn_4 (T=3012) leaves Marlin entirely (MARLIN_MAX_TOKENS 1024), removing this hypothesis's main target shape anyway.
interference: No companion and no waiting are warranted. The change is already on master, so no result of the running first-turn persistent-grid or turn_4 control checks can make it informative. Only a new mechanism on the Marlin path would justify a run, e.g. fusing the _local_expert_ids remap into _align_parallel together with something else measurable.
rules_flags: None (device-side local_start, no host sync), but moot because nothing would be built.
open_questions: Move this to done/rejected (duplicate of stack-tonight-five-prefill) and add it to FINDINGS 'Do not retry', so /hypothesize stops re-minting the Marlin-path align+silu pair.
